description: Add a record to a list of a Spryloom page that saves data, or change or delete a record the signed-in person saved themselves. Only when the user asks for that change. Records others saved can be changed only in the page itself.

data.description: The record, as a JSON object. Needed to add or change.

id.description: The record's id, from page_data. Needed to change or delete.

page.description: The page's address, or its name in your workspace.

name: save_page_record
